translations.web: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
translations.bsb: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their hearts. You will incline Your ear,
translations.kjv: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:
